name: Northwind Logistics
summary: Usage collapsed after a carrier API change broke the TMS integration on May 28, and the champion departed June 5 with no replacement sponsor. Risk is product-reliability and relationship, not commercial. Needs an integration fix sprint plus executive re-engagement before the October renewal.

name: Helios Analytics
last_signal: Hit 95% seat utilization; 3 new teams piloting
summary: Seat-saturated promoter (NPS 9) with three departments borrowing logins and an approved budget. Tier-mapped need for SSO/SCIM makes this a textbook product-qualified expansion worth roughly +150k ARR, plus a reference and case-study opportunity.

name: Brightpath Education
summary: Onboarding is behind plan (2 of 7 milestones at day 45) because the customer's IT admin is consumed by semester-start work. Cooperative but capacity-constrained. Needs an onboarding rescue: implementation specialist, a two-week milestone sprint, async training, and a sponsor checkpoint.

name: Atlas Manufacturing
last_signal: Renewal in 65 days; new VP evaluating competitor
summary: Strong product adoption (90% seats active) but a newly hired VP with no relationship is running a competitive evaluation and procurement wants 12% off. The risk is relationship and commercial, not value. Lead with an ROI business review, then counter with a multi-year structure.

name: Vertex Financial
last_signal: Sev-1 outage during quarter close; exec escalation open
summary: A Sev-1 six-hour outage during quarter-end close triggered a formal executive escalation with explicit churn language. Highest-priority account this week: same-day VP apology, RCA within 48 hours, remediation roadmap, proactive SLA credit, and a weekly exec check-in.

name: Cobalt Retail Group
last_signal: Steady usage; NPS 9 from economic buyer
summary: Healthy, steady account with a reference-willing promoter (NPS 9) and one minor enhancement request. No churn risk. Three new store regions launch in Q4, making this a future expansion candidate to nurture rather than an active save or upsell today.
